subject: Console guided onboarding checklist — beta rollout / feature flag
content:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Console guided onboarding checklist — beta rollout / feature flag

Hi all — sharing the proposed Console rollout plan for the guided onboarding checklist (Hosted API Phase 1). Main goal is to get alignment on: (1) feature flag targeting strategy, (2) beta cohort + comms, and (3) which release train we hang this on.

Proposed approach (beta):

1) Feature flag strategy
- Flag key: console_guided_onboarding_checklist
- Default: OFF for all orgs
- Targeting rules (in priority order):
  a) Admin override (kill switch + force enable/disable per org)
  b) Allowlist orgs (beta customers + internal dogfood)
  c) “New orgs” cohort (org_created_at >= 2026-02-24) at 10% initial exposure
- Region: start US-only for beta (reduce variables while we verify telemetry + validators). EU/APAC stays off.

2) What “beta” includes (Console)
- Checklist UI shell (sidebar card on Project Overview)
- Step state read/write + persistence
- Validated steps we can support in beta:
  - API key created (test)
  - First successful request (per project)
  - First streaming session (per project)
  - Visited usage dashboard (client-side event)
  - “Production key created” (prod vs test key label)
- Non-validated steps remain “learn” steps with doc links.

3) Beta cohort proposal (first 2 weeks)
- New orgs: 10% of eligible new signups (expected ~50–80 orgs/week)
- Allowlist: 3–5 existing accounts that opted into feedback
  - Candidate list in attached CSV (Aurora Labs, PineconeAI, Northstar Finance, + 2 tbd)
- Goal: learn quickly on UX + step ordering + validator lag (first_success and streaming)

4) Release train / timing
- Console release cut: aiming for week of Feb 24 (R-2026.03.0 train)
- Beta flag ON for allowlist + new org % starting Feb 25 (after deploy confirmed)
- Beta readout end of week Mar 6

Asks:
- Alex: confirm we’re good with new-org-first % rollout + allowlist (no blanket enable)
- Nikhil: sanity check re: “first success” validator lag + what we should call out as limitation
- Tessa: confirm the beta UX entry point is acceptable (Project Overview card vs modal), plus any “don’t do this” for first-run
- Elliot: confirm doc URLs + redirect readiness by Feb 24, and whether you want UTM tags on Console deep links for funnel attribution

Attaching the rollout plan PDF + draft allowlist CSV.

Thanks,
Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Console & Rollouts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: console-checklist-rollout-plan-2026-02.pdf
Attachment: beta-cohort-proposed-allowlist-2026-02-05.csv


From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Console guided onboarding checklist — beta rollout / feature flag

This looks directionally right.

Two things I want tightened up before we flip anything on:
1) Rollback ownership + triggers. If telemetry starts dropping (missing events, lag > X mins) or validators are marking false positives, who is on point and what is the immediate “off switch” plan?
2) Existing accounts: I’m ok with a small allowlist, but we should avoid surprise UI changes for established orgs unless they explicitly opted in (esp. if their projects are already in production). Please make sure allowlist is opt-in only.

Otherwise: new-org-first at 10% + US-only is a good risk posture.

-Alex


From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 11:16 AM PST
Subject: Re: Console guided onboarding checklist — beta rollout / feature flag

+1 overall.

On “first successful request”:
- Validator source (gateway logs/metrics) is still subject to a few mins of ingestion lag. For beta I’d message this as “usually within a few minutes” but set expectations that it can take up to ~15 mins in edge cases.
- We should be careful about what counts as “success”: I’d keep it to HTTP 2xx from the API gateway with a model route hit (not just auth success). Otherwise we’ll accidentally complete the step for users who only ping /health or similar.

On cohort selection:
- Northstar is the most compliance-sensitive on your list. If they’re in allowlist, I want confirmation they understand: (a) no prompts are collected, (b) event properties are allowlisted/redacted, (c) retention is per the privacy review doc. (Elliot / PM team can help with wording but don’t want surprises.)

Also: can we make sure Support has a heads-up + a link they can send customers who ask “why did my Console change?”

-Nikhil


From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 12:02 PM PST
Subject: Re: Console guided onboarding checklist — beta rollout / feature flag

For beta, Project Overview card entry point is OK.

A couple UX constraints (to avoid making this feel “in the way”):
- Don’t auto-open the checklist on first login. Surface it as a subtle card with a single CTA (e.g., “Start checklist”).
- If no API key exists yet, the first step should be the only expanded one (progressive disclosure). The rest should be collapsed with “Locked until…” copy.
- Please avoid showing “0/9 complete” as the primary headline (it reads like a failure state). Prefer “Get to your first production launch” with a progress indicator secondary.

If we can’t implement the progressive disclosure in time for Feb 24, I’d still ship beta but keep the copy gentle and remove any “blocked” styling.

Tessa


From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 1:37 PM PST
Subject: Re: Console guided onboarding checklist — beta rollout / feature flag

Docs side:
- We can be ready by Feb 24 for the new “First production launch” page + troubleshooting page updates.
- Redirects/version-stable URLs: we need final canonical URLs from design/PM no later than Feb 10 to set redirects and nav safely.

Re: UTM tags
- Yes, please add UTMs to Console deep links (source=console, medium=onboarding_checklist, campaign=guided_onboarding_beta, content=<step_slug>). That will help with attribution in the docs analytics and let Mei correlate doc visits with checklist completion.

One more request: please confirm if we’re linking to “latest” docs or a versioned path. My preference is version-stable (so the deep links don’t break) + a banner on docs if content changes.

-Elliot


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 6, 2026 at 9:08 AM PST
Subject: Re: Console guided onboarding checklist — beta rollout / feature flag

Thanks all — updates + responses below.

Rollback ownership/triggers (Alex):
- Primary on point: Console on-call (Dylan’s rotation) for deploy issues; Telemetry on-call for pipeline regressions.
- Immediate rollback path:
  1) Flip console_guided_onboarding_checklist OFF globally (kill switch)
  2) If needed, also disable validators server-side (so step state won’t change) while leaving UI hidden
- Proposed “flip OFF” triggers during beta:
  - Missing onboarding events >2% in a 30-min window (per region) OR
  - Event lag p95 > 10 mins for 30 mins OR
  - Sudden step completion anomaly (e.g., first_success completion jumps without corresponding request volume)

Existing accounts allowlist (Alex):
- Agreed: allowlist is opt-in only. We’ll only enable for accounts with explicit written OK (CS will confirm).

Validator caveats (Nikhil):
- We’ll message: “step completion may take up to ~15 minutes” in an info tooltip (beta only).
- Success definition: HTTP 2xx + model route hit; no /health.

Northstar / privacy (Nikhil):
- We’ll keep Northstar as “pending” until Marcus/Michael confirm we can provide the short privacy blurb. If there’s any risk here, we’ll drop them from beta allowlist.

UTMs + URL stability (Elliot):
- We’ll implement UTMs as you specified.
- We’ll link to version-stable canonical pages (not “latest” anchors).

Next steps / deadlines:
- By Feb 10: finalize canonical doc URLs + step slugs for UTMs
- By Feb 13: final beta allowlist confirmed (opt-in)
- Feb 24 week: deploy + enable beta (US-only)

If everyone’s aligned, I’ll update the rollout plan doc + create a short internal go/no-go checklist for Feb 24.

Marissa


From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 4:28 PM PST
Subject: Re: Console guided onboarding checklist — beta rollout / feature flag

Aligned.

Please add one more go/no-go item: Support enablement must be ready before allowlist accounts get the flag (macro + internal FAQ + where to escalate “reset checklist state” requests).

Otherwise proceed with the plan.

-Alex
